subject: Animation
title: Walt Disney: The Visionary Showman
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Walt Disney: The Visionary Showman.

hook.text: Walt Disney was not animation's best artist, but he was its greatest visionary and risk-taker.

buildup.text: Disney pushed animation toward realism, emotion, and narrative — turning a novelty into a storytelling medium.

discovery.text: He bet his entire company on Snow White. Hollywood called it Disney's Folly and predicted total failure.

twist.text: Snow White earned $8 million in 1937 — equivalent to over $160 million today — proving everyone wrong.

climax.text: Disney's willingness to risk everything on animation's potential transformed it into a respected art form.

punchline.text: Disney's Folly became Disney's fortune and animation's future.

quiz.question: Why was Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs called 'Disney's Folly'?
options: Hollywood predicted a feature-length animated film would be a total financial failure
Disney made the film without a script
